```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(MASS)
library(broom)
library(knitr)

# --- Theme Setup (Retained as per original scripts) ---
nature_colors <- c("#0173B2", "#DE8F05", "#029E73", "#CC78BC",
                  "#CA9161", "#949494", "#ECE133", "#56B4E9")

theme_nature <- function(base_size = 8) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())

# --- Data Loading and Processing (Modified: Removed VJU and Phase variables) ---
dat <- read_csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  mutate(
    # NOTE: Phase variable removed as per request
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q4", "Q3", "Q2", "Q1")),
    leadership = case_when(
      vn_led == 1 ~ "VN-led",
      jp_led == 1 ~ "JP-led",
      TRUE ~ "Other-led"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("Other-led", "JP-led", "VN-led")),
    age = 2025 - year,
    macro_area = case_when(
      HS == 1 ~ "HS",
      LS == 1 ~ "LS",
      PS == 1 ~ "PS",
      SS == 1 ~ "SS",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ) |> factor(),
    # NOTE: VJU-affiliated analysis removed as per request
    coop_type = factor(coop, levels = c("bilateral", "multilateral"))
  )
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  count(year) |>
  arrange(year) |>
  mutate(growth = (n / lag(n) - 1) * 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = n), fill = "#4A90E2", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = growth * 10), color = "#E85D75", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = growth * 10), color = "#E85D75", size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Publications",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 10, name = "Growth rate (%)")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year")
```


```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  filter(!is.na(quartile)) |>
  count(year, quartile) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = quartile)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Q1" = "#4A90E2", "Q2" = "#95B8A8", 
               "Q3" = "#E8B861", "Q4" = "#E85D75")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of publications", color = "Quartile")
```



```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

dat |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    ci_lower = mean_prop - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = mean_prop + 1.96 * se
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_prop)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), 
              alpha = 0.2, fill = "#4A90E2") +
  geom_line(color = "#4A90E2", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#4A90E2", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "#E85D75", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.3, 0.6), 
                     labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Mean Vietnamese author proportion")
```

dat |>

```{r}
dat |>
  group_by(leadership) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean = round(mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Median = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q25 = quantile(cited, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q75 = quantile(cited, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>

```{r}

dat |>

  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +

               fill = "white", color = "black") +

```



```{r}
# Filter data for model fitting (excluding NA values for predictors)
model_data <- dat |>
  filter(!is.na(cited), !is.na(leadership), !is.na(quartile),
         !is.na(fund), !is.na(OA), !is.na(coop), !is.na(macro_area)) |>
  mutate(
    prop_vn_centered = scale(prop_vn_authors, scale = FALSE)[,1],
    quartile_q1 = factor(if_else(quartile == "Q1", "Q1", "Other"), 
                         levels = c("Other", "Q1"))
  )

# --- 1. Fit Poisson and Negative Binomial Models for LR Test ---

# Reference Model (Poisson) - Assumes Equi-dispersion
m_poisson <- glm(cited ~ leadership + factor(year) + macro_area + OA + fund + coop,
                 data = model_data, family = poisson)

# Alternative Model (Negative Binomial) - Accounts for Over-dispersion
m_nb_base <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + factor(year) + macro_area + OA + fund + coop,
                    data = model_data)

# Perform Likelihood Ratio Test (LR Test)
# LR test compares the two models to determine if NB is significantly better (i.e., if alpha is non-zero)
lr_test_result <- anova(m_poisson, m_nb_base)
lr_p_value <- lr_test_result$`Pr(>Chi)`[2] # Extracting the p-value

# --- 2. Extract Dispersion Parameter (Theta) for NB ---
theta <- m_nb_base$theta

# --- Display Results ---
tibble(
  Test = c("Model Dispersion (Theta)", "LR Test (Poisson vs. NB)"),
  Value = c(round(theta, 3), paste("p =", format.pval(lr_p_value, digits = 3))),
  Interpretation = c(
    paste("Theta > 0 confirms over-dispersion. Theta =", round(theta, 3)),
    "p < 0.001 (Null Hypothesis: Equi-dispersion) is rejected, justifying NB model choice."
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Model Selection Justification (Citations)")

# Note: The Vuong test for ZINB is computationally intensive and the manuscript determined 
# ZINB unnecessary. We proceed with NB as justified by the LR test.
```


```{r}
# Model 1 (Base): Leadership + Time + Discipline (Reference: Other-led)
m1 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + factor(year) + macro_area,
             data = model_data)

# Model 3 (Full Controls): Add Collaboration, Authorship Balance, Funding, Quality (Quartile)
m3 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership + coop + prop_vn_centered +
               fund + bilateral_funding + OA + quartile +
               factor(year) + macro_area,
             data = model_data)

# Model 4 (Interactions): Test if VN-led gap is eliminated under favorable conditions
# Using Q1 vs. Other (quartile_q1) as a simplified quality control for interaction clarity
m4 <- glm.nb(cited ~ leadership * fund + leadership * quartile_q1 + 
               coop + prop_vn_centered + bilateral_funding + OA +
               factor(year) + macro_area,
             data = model_data)
```



```{r}
list(
  "Model 1 (Base)" = m1,
  "Model 3 (Full Controls)" = m3
) |>
  map_dfr(~{
    tidy(., conf.int = TRUE) |>
      filter(str_detect(term, "leadership")) |>
      transmute(
        term = term,
        IRR = exp(estimate),
        CI_lower = exp(conf.low),
        CI_upper = exp(conf.high),
        p.value = p.value
      )
  }, .id = "Model") |>
  mutate(
    across(IRR:p.value, ~round(., 3)),
    Sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Table 2. Leadership effects (Incident Rate Ratios)")
```



```{r}
# Fixing the final chunk by making the prediction robust

# 1. Ensure model_data is available and has the necessary columns (as defined in the successful chunk)
# ... (model_data definition and m4 fitting) ...

# 2. Add predicted values to the full model_data first
plot_data_full <- model_data |>
  # Add predictions for all rows (must be done outside of the summarise for stability)
  mutate(predicted_cited = predict(m4, newdata = model_data, type = "response")) |>
  filter(leadership %in% c("VN-led", "JP-led"))

# 3. Aggregate the predicted values
plot_data_aggregated <- plot_data_full |>
  group_by(leadership, fund) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pred = mean(predicted_cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Recalculate SE of original cited values for the error bars (optional but good practice)
    se = sd(cited, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(plot_data_aggregated, aes(x = fund, y = mean_pred, color = leadership, group = leadership)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_pred - 1.96*se, 
                    ymax = mean_pred + 1.96*se),
                width = 0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("VN-led" = "#4A90E2", "JP-led" = "#E85D75")) +
  labs(x = "Funding status", y = "Predicted citations (Model 4)", color = NULL)
```
